messages.content:
This is likely due to the change in the Pokémon Card Season. The schedule for the 2027 Season was announced at the recent Pokémon Japan Championship, and as shown in the linked article, the new season will begin in September. Since the Pokémon World Championship takes place at the end of August, it’s likely that the new season outside of Japan will also begin in September. Since this competition ranking will be finalized on August 31, this change is believed to be largely influenced by the change in the season.
